TC-147.method: Run the intake suite against real git repos, red-then-green per trigger (trigger (b) keys on the close's immutable REPORT PATH, so a re-sweep dedupes exactly and a genuinely second close is a second row): an approved SR amendment mints ONE adjudication row (id max+1, the before/after listing in ## Context) and an LLR SR-Refs re-point mints while a Module-only move stays silent (the ruled routing); a merged handback mints the disposition row (NEEDS-HUMAN reason routes strong; a handed-back adjudication row mints NOTHING and its own handback attempt is refused structurally); a primary adjudication's reviewed ## Approval/Dispositions, exact accepted scoped Status/snapshot effects with snapshots equal to live bytes and every absorbed changed cell accepted in the bound ledger, exact spec_move close (queued-to-complete move, cleared specref, fixed Deliverable before Context and only derived link rebasing), successors, watermark and declared generated records are derived by the stage-only writer and land in one atomic publication; stale, out-of-scope, malformed or UNJUDGED input stages nothing; a requested equivalent approval blocked by another scoped owner's UNJUDGED drift remains pending, then an adjudicator-revised RETURN with zero accepted cells and a dependency-preserving continuation closes atomically with no Status/snapshot write; the later complete-scope reanchor independently judges every cell and treats those RETURN findings as evidence only; crash-before remains pending and crash-after derives complete without a duplicate id; planmode=dual passes through kind-derived, and a malformed block, an unknown key, a second adjudication kind or a bad bar value refuse with nothing minted; the census mints gap rows once and dedupes on re-run; every re-run is idempotent by exact-title dedup; the context block renders every join in failure-cost order and answers the empty string on a bare repo; both gate-policy arms enact (attended recommends and leaves the registries byte-identical; single-approve and autonomous flip only the named Status cells, cell-exact elsewhere, idempotent).

TC-205.method: The verdict record's two halves, each driven beside its opposite so neither reads as a rule with one answer. THE IDENTITY, pure over synthetic `git ls-tree -r` entries: a listing and the same listing plus a round file, a log fragment and a session log fold EQUAL, while a changed work blob and a changed docs/work/ spec each fold DIFFERENT - so the exclusion is proven to be an exclusion rather than a fold that ignores everything. THE ENCODING BOUNDARY, driven through git rather than asserted about it: a record path holding a non-ASCII character - the shape git QUOTES, asserted in the fixture so it cannot silently stop reproducing - leaves the identity unmoved, while an accented WORK path moves it; and raw listings with one blob renamed from invalid-UTF-8 path byte 200 to 201 - asserted to COLLIDE under replacement decoding - fold DIFFERENT through tree_identity, so parsing and the ASCII record-prefix boundary occur before any decode. THE TRAILER GRAMMAR: format/parse round-trip; the LAST trailer in a message governs, so a rework commit quoting the round it answers does not have the quotation read as its own attestation; and three malformed shapes - a verdict word outside the enum, a 40-hex tree, a missing round count - each fail to PARSE rather than parse to something. THE NAME PARSE: a round file with and without the relaxed tag, the pre-train flat layout, a session log, and the legacy hand-authored rollup answering None because it names no reviewed sha. THE GATE, on a two-branch git fixture with the trunk checked out: a logged reviewer round naming the current tree clears it with NO rollup present anywhere; the same file with a BUILD session log behind it does not (the implementer-authored round); a SECOND round file committed behind that ONE session log, whose NAME claims the other declared phase, is not a second reviewer - both files are asserted committed and the single log with them, the entries carry the LOG's phase, so at a declared policy of 2 REVIEW-B is still outstanding and the gate refuses by name until a REVIEW-B whose own session log declares it arrives and clears it; TWO session logs at ONE (train, ordinal) declaring DIFFERENT review phases - both asserted committed, with the round file they would otherwise phase asserted still present so the empty answer is the ambiguity rule and not an empty scan - serve NO round at all rather than letting the last log read win, and the gate refuses by name while the single-log arm beside it clears; a round whose tree was reworked away does not, while a log-fragment and scoreboard commit after a round leaves it governing; a CHANGES-REQUESTED round refuses; and a verified Review-Verdict trailer contradicting the rounds refuses by name in its verdict word and in a round count ABOVE the evidence, while a count BELOW it does NOT - both directions driven, because the writer is best-effort and a stamp the evidence outruns is a missed stamp whose refusal parked an approved lane at the very stop the cross-check exists to prevent - and TWO attestations at one governing tree leave the NEWEST governing so a legitimately re-drawn round is not accused of forgery. THE CARRIER IS VERIFIED AND NOT ONLY PARSED, which is what "the trailer cannot create an approval" costs: the identical attestation words on a commit that CHANGED the work under them - asserted in the fixture to have really moved the governing identity - are read at neither the tree they NAME nor the tree they rode, beside the record-only carrier of the same words that IS read, so copying a true attestation onto later work buys nothing. THE WRITER IS DRIVEN END TO END, not only the trailer helper: a completed round is run through the loop's own complete_review_round on a repository fixture and the commit it lands is asserted to CARRY the attestation, to name the governing tree, to be read back by the branch reader under the key the cross-check looks up, to leave that governing tree unmoved, and to satisfy the gate - the whole path between a round completing and its attestation landing, which every other trailer case skipped by committing the string itself, and which nothing anywhere reports when it stops writing because absence is the state the cross-check must stand down on. THE RESUME'S OWED SET IS THE EVIDENCE'S ALONE: with both declared phases served at the governing tree and a stale untracked owed-marker still present - the state a run killed between the last reviewer's commit and the round completing leaves - the resume is asserted to queue NOTHING, and beside it a genuine rework with one phase redrawn is asserted to queue that phase and only it. THE PEEL: a genuine Bar-Green refresh commit, verified against its own tree and parent, moves the branch tip's identity and neither reader's answer - the loop still says no round is owed and the gate still merges - which is the one commit class two separately-chosen revs disagreed on; and the same refresh with a coordinator TELEMETRY commit stacked on top of it - a record path, so the fold ignores it and only the tip-only peel could be defeated by it - still owes no round and still merges. THE PRIMARY ADJUDICATION CARRIER: verify recognition of the exact publication constructed under TC-147 and exclusively owned under TC-148. Only a verified carrier maps the final tree to its reviewed candidate; forged subject, wrong WI/turn, stale proposal or candidate, extra/missing path, cross-WI close, malformed successor, partial snapshot and unreviewed decision each fail toward more review. Construction, exact close transformation, accepted effects, allocation, atomicity and crash/replay proofs belong to TC-147; lock/exclusion/directive proofs belong to TC-148. THE TWO PEELS' REFUSAL ARMS are held by tests/test_integrate_station.py, cited beside this module because integrate re-exports these very functions (refresh_attestation, work_tip) and the station suite is where a refresh can be produced rather than hand-written: a genuine refresh attested to the sha it produced; a forged Bar-Green trailer in three shapes, the sharpest being a genuine refresh message copied verbatim onto another commit; an amend that keeps the message while the tree moves, revoking the attestation; the deliberately forged attestation recorded as a STATED limit rather than a defence; and the reset peel's data-loss half - an honest work commit merely QUOTING the trailer is never peeled away, and a genuine refresh above it peels back to exactly that commit. BOTH carriers are driven, not only the convenient one: that non-empty telemetry commit, and then the EMPTY commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes when a Review-Verdict attestation must land on unchanged bookkeeping - obtained by CALLING that producer rather than by hand, so the two cannot drift apart, and asserted to really be zero-path, because that is the commit shape a walk classifying PATHS could not classify and so stopped at, burying the refresh under the very commit that recorded the approval. A WORK commit above the refresh does re-owe and does refuse, so the walk is proven to step through what cannot invalidate a verdict rather than through everything. BOTH ORDERS of refresh and round, because only one of them was covered and the other was broken: the round drawn AFTER the refresh - the order the shipped path actually produces, since a lane's refresh is spawned as soon as its worker is DONE and before the merge slot runs, so any slot refusal parks a branch with a refresh and no round - cites the POST-refresh sha, asserted in the fixture to be that sha and not the pre-refresh one, and is asserted to serve the lane at both readers and to carry the coordinator's attestation under the key the cross-check looks it up by, while a rework above it still re-owes. THE ATTESTATION'S CARRIER IS SCOPED TO ITS OWN PATHS, on BOTH arms and not only the one that carries a pathspec: with an unrelated work file staged and the bookkeeping unchanged, the commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes for NAMED paths and the one it writes for NO paths at all - the call this suite itself makes, and the arm where a scope appended only when paths exist evaporates - are each asserted zero-path with the caller's index left exactly as found, so work cannot land under a bookkeeping label nor an attestation ride a commit that changed the tree. THE DIAL: retain the historical lane matrix, unknown-value fallback to when-minting and no-review lane-close cases as ordinary-lane proofs. Separately drive actual pending-primary selection and publication under never, when-minting and always with ordinary, spine and derived-dual successor drafts: no-review returns publish without a reviewer round; review-owed returns refuse with no staged or committed effects until independent fixture evidence serves the phase. THE DIAL AT THE SCHEDULER: committing ADJUDICATE bookkeeping on the same pending-primary repositories produces the expected review queue, train-scoped diff range and judging family. THE SHARED INPUT: compare the queued adjudication spec before publication with its terminal copy after verified publication; successor drafts remain the same, the verified carrier preserves the governing candidate identity and served phases remain served. Ordinary branches retain terminal-before-active precedence, driven by the historical shared-spec fixture. THE SHARED DEFINITION, in BOTH its dimensions. WHICH TREE: the C2 review-owed derivation answers owed after a rework and served after a fresh round, and record-only commits after the verdict re-owe nothing. HOW MANY PHASES: at a declared policy of 2 a lone logged REVIEW-A APPROVE is REFUSED by name and the gate clears only once a governing REVIEW-B joins it at the same identity; and the half-drawn round a killed run leaves - REVIEW-A served, the in-memory phase queue gone - is answered by both readers together, the derivation naming REVIEW-B and ONLY REVIEW-B while the gate refuses, then both agreeing once it lands, with the same fixture asserted SERVED at policy 1 so the answer is proven to come from the declared count. The phase span is driven pure at the values neither caller reaches - a negative policy, which a bare slice would answer by slicing from the END, and an over-dialled one - and the one class the two readers must disagree on is pinned: a drawn but UNPARSEABLE verdict is not re-drawn and does not clear the gate either. THE TIER IS THE WHOLE CITED SET'S, not the majority's: the cited integration-station, primary-approval and primary-publication cases include modules named in tests/conftest.py SLOW_MODULES and so deselected by `-m smoke`, so Full is the cheapest tier at which EVERY arm above actually runs and Smoke would have claimed commit-floor coverage for a set the commit floor only partly runs. Tier and the pytest marker remain independent declarations that no check compares (registry-machinery-reference §12.2); this cell is labelled on the side that under-claims.
